operator_summary: Capital Hilton has ten missing proof items. This contract asks bounded ELIWINSHIP questions, records answers as memory candidates unless they link to proof metadata, and keeps all finance/account/action authority blocked.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Can we point to protected proof that the May 8, 2026 Capital Hilton performance happened?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet only after protected proof metadata or a valid rejected/obsolete receipt is linked.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: a candidate date copied from an old packet without a receipt
what_would_satisfy_this: protected evidence reference for the May 8 performance
approved source-card metadata with a receipt
Guardian-reviewed calendar, contract, AP, or event proof metadata
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: A future invoice packet cannot treat the May 8 service date as billable until a protected source reference or receipt backs it.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Can we point to protected proof that the May 15, 2026 Capital Hilton performance happened?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet only after protected proof metadata or a valid rejected/obsolete receipt is linked.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: a candidate date copied from an old packet without a receipt
what_would_satisfy_this: protected evidence reference for the May 15 performance
approved source-card metadata with a receipt
Guardian-reviewed calendar, contract, AP, or event proof metadata
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: The second service date affects subtotal, one-invoice posture, and whether the lane can move toward Finance.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Can we point to proof that the agreed rate was $400 per gig?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet only after rate proof metadata is linked or the candidate rate is rejected with a receipt.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: a candidate rate without source metadata
what_would_satisfy_this: contract/rate source-card metadata
protected reference to a rate agreement
Guardian-reviewed AP or packet metadata that states the rate
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: The rate drives the invoice math and must be source-backed before any future invoice generation can be considered.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Can deterministic math prove 2 gigs x $400 = $800 from accepted source facts?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after a deterministic math receipt links accepted date and rate proof.
what_would_satisfy_this: deterministic math receipt using two accepted performance dates and accepted $400 rate
receipt showing source fact refs used for the calculation
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: The subtotal can be proven by deterministic math only after the date count and rate are accepted source facts.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Should these two dates be billed together on one invoice, and what proof supports that?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after one-invoice posture is source-backed, parked with reason, or rejected with receipt.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: implicit grouping because dates are close together
what_would_satisfy_this: source-card or AP instruction metadata supporting one invoice
operator answer plus source/protected reference
receipt rejecting one-invoice posture if it is wrong
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: Invoice shape affects future packet generation and must not be inferred from convenience alone.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Is there a Coupa, PO, payment, or reference number that needs to appear on the invoice packet?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after protected metadata identifies the reference or a receipt states none is required.
what_would_satisfy_this: metadata-only Coupa/PO/payment reference
Guardian-reviewed protected evidence reference
receipt that no PO/payment reference is needed
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: A future invoice packet may need a PO or payment reference, but Coupa/account access is blocked now.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Is there an Excel workbook, invoice template, or source artifact that should be referenced without ingesting the raw body?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after source artifact metadata is linked or the artifact is rejected as irrelevant with a receipt.
what_would_satisfy_this: metadata-only file/source-card reference
hash or receipt for the artifact reference
Guardian-reviewed redaction posture
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: Workbook or invoice-template context can guide future packet shape, but raw spreadsheet/PDF body ingestion is blocked.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: What is the approved AP route or recipient path, without sending anything yet?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after the AP route is protected-metadata linked, parked for discovery, or rejected with reason.
what_would_satisfy_this: metadata-only AP route/source-card
protected recipient route reference
receipt that route is unknown and needs discovery
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: Recipient route affects future send/submit decisions, which remain blocked until explicit future authority exists.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: Are there tax, vendor, W-9, entity, or payment-handling details that affect the invoice packet?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet after protected metadata resolves relevance or a rejection/obsolete receipt is linked.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: operator memory without a protected reference
what_would_satisfy_this: metadata-only vendor/tax/payment handling reference
Guardian-reviewed protected reference
receipt that this detail is not needed for the packet
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: Tax/vendor/payment handling may change packet requirements and requires protected metadata boundaries.

proof_intake_items.eliwinship_question: What receipt would prove a future invoice was generated correctly, if invoice generation is ever approved later?
proof_intake_items.quiet_condition: Quiet only as a future receipt requirement; it does not authorize invoice generation.
what_would_not_satisfy_this: an operator statement that it looks right
send/submit/approval proof because those actions are blocked now
what_would_satisfy_this: future invoice generation receipt contract
source fact refs, math refs, artifact hash, operator/Guardian gates, and blocked send status
Security Delta or Security Repass approval for any future action class
proof_intake_items.why_it_matters: Even if future invoice generation is approved, it needs a deterministic receipt shape before any action lane can run.
